episodes.synopsis: Kamui, a rogue ninja, is saved by siblings Nene and Ryuta but is soon pursued by assassins seeking revenge.
episodes.title: Sparrow Drop

episodes.synopsis: Kamui escapes into the forest, where he uses a secret technique to battle the tree-fighting Masira clan.
episodes.title: Izuna Drop

episodes.synopsis: Ryuta follows Kamui, but after Tsukikage attacks, Kamui warns him of a ninja's perilous life and tries to send him back to his sister.
episodes.title: Moon Shadow

episodes.synopsis: Kamui battles ninja siblings Sanae and Shirou, and after defeating Shirou, he faces Sanae's revenge with her secret technique, "Iizuna Gaeshi."
episodes.title: Flying Squirrel

episodes.synopsis: Kamui hears of the undefeated ninja Mitsu of Nabari, who breaks Kamui's Kiri Slash, prompting him to seek the secret behind Mitsu's invincibility.
episodes.title: The Five

episodes.synopsis: Kamui faces an assassin with the mind-reading technique "Tashin Tsū," forcing him to use a life-risking strategy to escape.
episodes.title: Wood Ear

episodes.synopsis: Assassin Heima suspects Kamui is the "werewolf" terrorizing a village but is trapped, while the werewolf saves his son, Taichi.
episodes.title: Common Wind

episodes.synopsis: Kamui joins the "Tozura Group" of woodcutters, protecting a mistreated girl, Tone, while uncovering a plot against him and growing closer to her.
episodes.title: The Ninth

episodes.synopsis: After betrayal, Kamui becomes paranoid, killing strangers he believes are assassins as a dark force takes control of him.
episodes.title: Dark Phantom

episodes.synopsis: Blinded in battle, Kamui is cared for by hunter Senkichi, who later betrays him for money when an assassin seeks information about Kamui.
episodes.title: Cicada Shell

episodes.synopsis: Kamui escapes to a farming village, working as a laborer and finding peace, but his tranquil life is short-lived.
episodes.title: The Servant

episodes.synopsis: Assassin Konoma, unsure if Kamui is truly blind, challenges him but is saved by Kamui, and ultimately chooses to become a rogue ninja like him.
episodes.title: Mad Horse

episodes.synopsis: After surviving a fall, the "Tengu" from Tanba resumes chasing Kamui and Konoma, but the mad horse reappears.
episodes.title: Celestial Being

episodes.synopsis: Kamui's paranoia leads to killings by an imposter using the "Ushimino" technique, who takes his appearance, while the real Kamui remains elsewhere.
episodes.title: Body Switch

episodes.synopsis: Tengu's subordinates consider becoming rogue ninjas, prompting O-Atama to use Hanzo to gain their trust.
episodes.title: Old Ninja
